title: HIGH: bbox-cull (task 1327) REORDERS top-wins z between untouched and merged shapes — drops existing↔existing cut
description:
FIXED (task 1329). Root cause: foldShapeIntoLayerCulled (merge.ts) folded only shapes overlapping the INCOMING stroke and re-emitted the rest UNTOUCHED below the merged object, reordering top-wins z between an untouched shape and a folded shape -> dropped existing<->existing cuts.

FIX: the cull now folds the TRANSITIVE OVERLAP CLOSURE of the incoming stroke (fixpoint: seed with shapes overlapping the stroke, then pull in any shape overlapping an already-folded shape), in original draw order; only shapes bbox-disjoint from the WHOLE interacting cluster stay untouched. Their z relative to the merged object is then geometrically irrelevant (disjoint -> no shared face). Result is geometrically IDENTICAL to the full whole-layer rebuild (foldShapeIntoLayer) for ALL inputs.

VERIFY: core engine 1195/1195 + authoring-ui 1022/1022 green (only the 3 pre-existing task-1207 flash8-empty.fla fixture files fail, fixture absent from checkout). 8 merge-drawing oracles diff=0/220000. New regression suite in planar-merge.test.ts (MINIMAL eBLUE/eRED/green case: RED keeps 600 not 400; 60-trial randomized fuzz culled==full; transitive-closure case) FAILS on pre-1329 code and PASSES after. Perf retained: 400-fill layer, stroke touching corner -> culled 0.50ms vs full-rebuild 280.77ms (565x), 397 fills kept untouched. Docs/36 §3.0e corrected.
